whatsappMessage:
Hi Team MV pro fitness,

I noticed your gym has exceptional 5.0★ reviews across 147 happy members in Mitra Mandal Colony, but lacked a dedicated mobile booking & batch schedule page.

Maine aapke gym ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp trial booking, workout programs, aur batch timings integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://mv-pro-fitness-demo.arclane.app

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team MV pro fitness, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke gym ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp trial booking and your amazing 5.0-star rating showcase for members in Mitra Mandal Colony. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact batch timings aur actual photos integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
